name: Never Saddle on Quality

angles.text: Amberstill Ranch's ram-breeding efforts directly supply mount reinforcements to Alliance forces operating in the freezing heights of Alterac.
Dun Morogh's hardy mountain rams are iconic dwarven mounts, and breeders at Amberstill Ranch refuse to equip them with substandard gear.
The task calls on skilled trackers and hunters to seek out Dun Morogh's fiercest mountain leopards to secure pristine pelts.

aliases: what is never saddle on quality
faq.answer: Never Saddle on Quality is a task based out of Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh. A breeder requires high-quality leopard pelts to craft sturdy, warm saddles for a team of rams being readied as reinforcements for the Alterac expedition.
faq.q: What is Never Saddle on Quality?

faq.answer: The pelts are needed to craft durable, warm saddles for expedition mounts. Dun Morogh's mountain leopards provide thick, insulating fur suited to protect riders and beasts against the biting mountain chill of Alterac.
The mounts are bound for Alliance forces engaged in the Alterac expedition. With harsh weather and ongoing operations in the high passes, well-equipped riding rams are essential support.
faq.q: Where are the rams being sent?

faq.answer: Amberstill Ranch is located in the snowy hills of Dun Morogh, east of Kharanos. It serves as the primary breeding and training ground for dwarven mountain rams.
faq.q: What is Amberstill Ranch's role here?

faq.answer: The fierce snow leopards roam the snowy ridges and crags to the east of Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh, where hunters must track the largest beasts to recover pristine hides.
The kingdom and peaks of Alterac are notoriously freezing and windswept. Without thick, high-quality saddle material, mounts and riders risk frostbite and exhaustion in the mountainous terrain.
faq.q: Why is cold weather protection so important for the expedition?

sections.body: At Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh, handlers are preparing a fresh team of sturdy mountain rams to reinforce the Alliance expedition operating in Alterac. However, preparations have stalled due to a shortage of suitable material needed to craft durable, cold-weather saddles for the beasts.
sections.title: Mounting the Expedition

sections.body: To withstand the punishing freeze of the Alterac mountains, the expedition mounts demand thick, high-grade insulation. Hunters are directed into the eastern crags to track down Dun Morogh's largest, fiercest mountain leopards and recover their pristine pelts, ensuring the Alliance forces receive gear built to survive the high passes.
sections.title: Warmth for the High Passes

summary: Never Saddle on Quality is an Alliance task centered at Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh. Handlers require pristine mountain leopard pelts to craft warm saddles for riding rams destined to reinforce the Alterac expedition. The effort ensures mounts and riders can endure the biting frost of the northern mountains.
